overview_description.description: Metriport is a healthcare data infrastructure company that provides tools for accessing, integrating, and analyzing patient records. Its platform connects healthcare data sources such as EHRs, health information exchanges, pharmacies, and laboratories, then normalizes the data into a unified FHIR-based format. Services include medical record retrieval, real-time event notifications, APIs, data warehousing, AI-powered record summaries, care gap identification, condition analysis, referrals, and clinical data exchange.

about_short_description.short_description: Metriport is a healthcare data infrastructure company that provides tools for accessing, integrating, and analyzing patient records.

product.name: Medical API
product.description: An open-source, FHIR-native REST API for retrieving and exchanging comprehensive patient medical records through major health information networks and exchanges.

product.name: Metriport Dashboard
product.description: A no-code provider interface for retrieving, organizing, and reviewing patients’ external medical records and clinical histories.

product.name: Real-time Patient Notifications
product.description: A patient-monitoring service that delivers alerts for admissions, discharges, transfers, prescriptions, and new laboratory results.

product.name: EHR Apps
product.description: Embedded and synchronization applications that bring external patient medical records into supported electronic health record workflows.
